text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir to address first parliament session on Sunday. The new all-male parliament was elected on October 7.

- Kuwait cabinet ministers to participate in election of new parliament speaker. Two main candidates are running -- former speaker, opposition vetran Ahmad al-Saadoun and former finance minister Jassem al-Kharafi.
- Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development signs draft accord for a $20 million loan for Lebanon.
- Gulf Arab immigration officials meet in Kuwait on Sunday.
- Baghdad informes the United Nations that Kuwait fired on an Iraqi research ship.
